codeReview.summary: The implementation footprint matches the feature intent: `internal/core/repositories.go` defines repository interfaces for users, auth challenges/password resets, projects, builds, deployments, operations, runners, telemetry, and artifacts; `Handler`, `Server`, actor grains, and actor node/runtime types now depend on `core.DataStore` instead of `*core.State`; and targeted greps found no `db.Exec`/`db.Query`/`db.QueryRow` or inline SQL usage in `internal/api/handler/` or `internal/actors/`. I did not find a blocking gap against VAL-BH-003 or VAL-BH-004.

issues.description: This commit also changes unsupported-message handling in several actors from explicit errors/responses to log-and-ignore behavior. `commandGatewayActor` now only logs and returns here, and similar changes appear in `build_actors.go:50` and `runner_actors.go:69,136,165`. That behavior drift is outside the repository-interface scope and can turn programmer mistakes into timeouts/harder debugging if an actor receives the wrong message type.
